title: AWS Glue Failures by Job
app: AWS Glue job runs via CloudWatch to the Splunk Add-on for AWS.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=aws:glue:jobrun job_run_state="FAILED" OR job_run_state="TIMEOUT"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by job_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts AWS Glue failures grouped by job so operators immediately see which specific jobs are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'AWS Glue is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest AWS Glue failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical jobs.
visualization: Table of job by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of AWS Glue are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
